📌 WHAT ARE TRADING EXIT CYCLES?

When funds are allocated to AI Trading, they are actively involved in the trading process.

Because of this, removing capital from trading is handled through trading exit cycles.

The system offers several options depending on the selected exit timeframe.

Trading exit options:

Fastest exit option
10% commission

2 days
5% commission

4 days
3% commission

6 days
2% commission

10 days
0% commission

The principle is simple:

Faster exit option = higher commission
Longer exit period = lower commission

Why?

The more time the system has to complete the trading exit, the lower the commission for removing funds from active trading.

What does “Instant Withdrawal” mean in the Trading Wallet?

You may currently see the fastest option displayed as Instant Withdrawal with a 10% commission.

This is the fastest available trading exit option, but it should not be understood as a guaranteed instant withdrawal.

Processing still requires time and is not guaranteed to be immediate.

It also does not mean that funds will instantly arrive in your external crypto wallet.

After the trading exit is completed, the funds first become available for withdrawal.

Only then can you submit a separate withdrawal request to your external wallet.

🎙 Iran and Iran did not let Western powers dictate their fate: Ghalibaf

📌 Tehran, IRNA - Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says the peoples of Iran and Iraq have refused to become footnotes in others’ narratives, insisting that their destiny will not be written in Western capitals.

Speaking at a ceremony in Karbala marking the 40th day since the burial of the late Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, Ghalibaf conveyed warm greetings from the Iranian leadership and nation to the Iraqi people on Thursday.
​
He praised the Iraqi nation for its historic funeral procession for the late leader, saying the Iraqi people had fully upheld the bonds of brotherhood and left the world astonished.
​
The Parliament speaker emphasized that every step taken by enemies to drive the two nations apart had only brought them closer together.
​
He cited the deep roots of the Iran-Iraq relationship in history, geography, and shared religious beliefs, but stressed that what has brought Tehran and Baghdad even nearer is their joint refusal to allow foreign capitals to shape their peoples’ futures.
​
“History will record that we were two nations who did not accept being a footnote to others’ narratives and did not allow our destiny to be written in the capitals of Western governments,” Ghalibaf said.
​
Iran’s top negotiator stressed that his visit to Iraq was not about repeating words without substance, adding that there was a clear agenda to enhance security and stability, limit foreign interference, and define projects that improve the lives of both nations.
​
“We have been friends and brothers in the toughest days,” he said. “We stood together in hardship and will stand together in success. In a word, our strength lies in our brotherhood.”
​
Ghalibaf arrived in Baghdad on Wednesday at the head of a high-level parliamentary delegation for talks with Iraqi officials on bilateral relations, border security, counterterrorism, economic cooperation, and regional developments.
